description: Create MatchFeatureSnapshot - canonical feature representation for one match containing all available data without fabrication. Integrates DataQualityGate and source provenance tracking.
steps: 1. Create backend/app/prediction/feature_snapshot.py with MatchFeatureSnapshot dataclass containing: match_identity, team_ids, competition, strength_metrics (home/away attack/defense), form_metrics (recent/opponent-adjusted), home_advantage, league_context, player_availability (injuries/suspensions/lineup_status), tactical_context, spatial_features, first_half_context, data_quality_metadata (DataQualityReport from DataQualityGate), source_provenance (per-field source tracking), market_context (odds if available), live_context (for future use). All fields Optional - None means unavailable, not zero.

2. Add MatchFeatureSnapshot.from_features(features: Dict, match: Match, data_quality_report: DataQualityReport) factory method that maps MatchFeatureExtractor output to the canonical snapshot structure.
3. Add MatchFeatureSnapshot.validate() method that ensures no field contains fabricated placeholder values (e.g., all strengths == 1.0 should trigger warning in metadata, not failure).
4. Add MatchFeatureSnapshot.to_dict() for serialization to AnalysisContext.

5. Integration: Modify MatchFeatureExtractor in backend/app/features/base.py to optionally return MatchFeatureSnapshot instead of raw dict via extract_snapshot(match: Match) -> MatchFeatureSnapshot method.
6. Wire DataQualityGate into feature extraction: call DataQualityGate.assess(features) and attach report to snapshot.data_quality_metadata.

7. Add unit tests in backend/tests/test_feature_snapshot.py covering: snapshot creation from features dict, validation of missing data (all None fields valid), validation rejecting fabricated uniform values, round-trip serialization via to_dict(), DataQualityGate integration.
acceptance_criteria: MatchFeatureSnapshot dataclass exists with all specified fields typed as Optional
Factory method from_features() correctly maps MatchFeatureExtractor output
Snapshot preserves None for unavailable data without converting to 0 or 1.0
